description: Helper functions for generating diffs between tree objects in a Git-like version control system, including path comparison, recursion checks, and rename following.

methods.name: is_dir_prefix
methods.description: Checks if 'dir' is a leading directory of 'path'.

methods.name: check_recursion_depth
methods.description: Determines if recursion should continue based on pathspec and max depth.

methods.name: should_recurse
methods.description: Decides if recursion is needed based on options and path.

methods.name: tree_entry_pathcmp
methods.description: Compares two tree entries based on path and mode, ignoring their SHA1s.

methods.name: emit_diff_first_parent_only
methods.description: Emits diff for the first parent only, used in diff generation.

methods.name: emit_path
methods.description: Generates and emits diff paths for tree entries, handling additions, deletions, and modifications.

methods.name: skip_uninteresting
methods.description: Skips tree entries that are not interesting based on the index and pathspec.

methods.name: ll_diff_tree_paths
methods.description: Recursively generates diff paths for trees and their parents, handling complex diff scenarios.

methods.name: diff_tree_paths
methods.description: Initiates diff path generation for a tree and its parents.

methods.name: diff_might_be_rename
methods.description: Checks if the diff could be a rename based on queued diffs.

methods.name: try_to_follow_renames
methods.description: Attempts to follow renames in the diff to produce more accurate diff paths.

methods.name: ll_diff_tree_oid
methods.description: Generates diff paths between two tree objects, handling renames and path changes.

methods.name: diff_tree_oid
methods.description: Generates diff paths between two tree objects with optional base path, handling renames if enabled.

methods.name: diff_root_tree_oid
methods.description: Generates diff paths from the root tree object with a specified base path.
